notes: "When I talk to an agent about my slides, I used to say: fix slide four. But if the order changed since the last version, slide four is a different slide. So HUANDENG separates the two. Position is just where a slide sits now. The Slide ID is a short four-character code, letters and numbers, that belongs to the slide for good. The status bar here shows Position moving from 2 to 4 while the Slide ID stays C014. Now I can say: fix the chart on C014, and the agent knows exactly which page I mean, next week as well as today. The same ID is what page history hangs on."

designIntent.purpose: Distinguish permanent Slide ID from derived Position and occurrence.
keep: Real status-bar captures before/after the move
designIntent.requestedChange: Story-driven rework: organise the founder's reasons for building HUANDENG and show the features that answer them.
